councilcraft.graphics.title: Choose your graphics preset
councilcraft.graphics.subtitle: You can change it later: Options > Video Settings > Graphics Preset
councilcraft.graphics.preset.high.hint: Gaming PC or laptop, about RTX 3060 / RX 6600 or better, 16 GB RAM
councilcraft.graphics.preset.medium.hint: Older gaming PC or decent laptop, about GTX 1060 / 1650, 8-16 GB RAM
councilcraft.graphics.preset.low.hint: Most laptops and office PCs, built-in graphics OK, 8 GB RAM
councilcraft.graphics.vanilla_look.hint: Turns off Fresh Animations and its add-ons, Punchy, Eating Animation, 3D lanterns, Connected Paths, better grass, connected glass and enchanted book covers. Vanilla Tweaks stays on. Untick to bring them back.
councilcraft.guide.title: Where to find mod settings
councilcraft.guide.line1: Most mods: Mods (on the title screen, or Mods in the pause menu), pick the mod, then its settings button.
councilcraft.guide.line2: Graphics and performance: Options > Video Settings (Sodium pages). Graphics Preset at the bottom left brings you back here.
councilcraft.guide.line3: Shaders: Video Settings > Shader Packs. K turns shaders on and off.
councilcraft.guide.line5: Keys: Options > Controls > Key Binds (with a search box). Controllers: Mods > Controlify.
councilcraft.guide.line6: Voice chat: Right Alt opens its menu (mic, volumes, groups). Zoom: hold C, or Mods > Zoomify.
councilcraft.guide.line7: Texture and animation packs: Options > Resource Packs, or tick Vanilla look on the Graphics Preset screen.
